title: Far Breton
description: Far Breton is a prune flan recipe from Brittany in Northwest France. It's very easy to make with dried pitted prunes, eggs, milk, vanilla sugar, and rum.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees F (230 degrees C). Grease a shallow 2-quart baking dish.

Heat prunes with enough water to cover in a saucepan to a simmer; simmer until prunes are tender but still hold their shape, about 10 minutes. Drain prunes; arrange in bottom of the prepared baking dish.

Whisk flour, white sugar, vanilla sugar, baking powder, and salt together in a large bowl. Whisk in eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition. Gradually pour in milk, stirring vigorously with a wooden spoon until combined. Stir in rum. Pour batter evenly over prunes.

Bake in the preheated oven for 10 minutes. Reduce the oven temperature to 400 degrees F (205 degrees C); bake until filling is firm, has risen a little, and top is browned, about 30 minutes. Serve warm or at room temperature.
